title: Crew dossier: REC head, code bar, rank marks, the hatched ghost word, the yellow column with the figure, the name in brackets, label / value chips, quote and bio
use: A character or crew introduction screen. The portrait slot takes a transparent figure (2120 x 2120 from the task sheet), or an instrument drawing for a showcase without characters.

col_x.note: yellow column x / W (656 units wide)

quote.default: “偏差零点三度，重测。这条线要走一百年。”

bio.default: 岑砚是第七导线队的测绘组长，也是缓行站上资历最老的现役队员。她习惯在日出前把晷针插进冻土，用影子校准当天的第一条基线。

relations: Column 656 x 1043 from the top; avatars 102 every 147 on a grey column; text column at x 367, 553 wide.
Name 58 bold between 40-unit grey brackets; chips 90 + 165 x 24 in two columns 285 apart, 48 between rows; voice rows yellow.
decoration: The ghost word, avatar circles, rank marks, badges, tape rules and the tri-code rule: drawn.

provenance.corpus: traverse case (远垦导线 TRAVERSE): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the frontier-survey grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/frontier-survey/style.json provenance (reference site measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: The case's crew section (site/index.html #crew) as a parametric screen; numbers from the reference's DOM.
measured: Reference: decoFlag clip 656 x 1043, hollow text 366 px at -0.08 em and 60% with a -45 degree stripe fill, switch items 102 every 147, title 58.5 px with 40.5 px brackets, label 90 x 24 and value 165 x 24 at 16.5 px.
Case first pass: the bracket glyphs in #8C8C8C measured 3.36:1; they are #6B6B6B.
